text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the support of her fans at her<n>back, Rice
Shower runs in the<n>Takarazuka Kinen. Although she
isn't<n>able to take the win...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She still sees how many people<n>she's made smile.
At last, she has<n>become the blue rose she always
aspired to be.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the race behind her, she decides<n>she wants to
run in the Arima Kinen<n>against Mihono Bourbon and
Mejiro<n>McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Like the Takarazuka Kinen, only<n>racers selected by
the fans can run in<n>the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her state her intention to run in<n>such a
prestigious race without a hint<n>of apprehension, I
can sense how<n>much Rice Shower has grown.
